name: Warrior of Legend
benefits: You may transcribe your knowledge of combat into writing. Any creatures that read your tome gain a +2 insight bonus on all attack rolls made while applying your teachings. You gain a +8 insight bonus to AC against any creatures applying your teachings in combat. Additionally, you cease to age so long as one copy of your teachings exists.
special: A creature with levels in a class that grants spellcasting cannot take this feat.
